result.summary: K5 PASSES: a consistent history exists for v21-F17-G3221 with explicit ranges. The exactly stable R-odd state is not coloured and not charged: at one loop the colour triplets of the 10_F are 0.3-0.5% heavier than the (1,2,2)_0 bidoublet in every content/scale variant, so the lightest is the neutral Higgsino-like Dirac member (or the SM-singlet N if y_1 < y_10); coloured components decay in 1e-8-5e-6 s. Its thermal abundance is governed by T_max ~ 0.45 (T_RH^2 H_I M_P)^{1/4}, with overclosure at M/T_max ~ 20-25: at the isocurvature-allowed H_I = 3e7 this gives T_RH <= 1.08e11 (M = 1e13) or 1.38e10 (M = 3e12), rising to 4e11 / 4.7e10 at H_I = 1e6 and capped at ~ M/27 for instant reheating; gravitational and inflaton channels are negligible if m_phi < 2 M. The axion has f_a = v_S/17 exactly (N_DW = 1, E/N = 8/3), m_a = 2.09-2.67 ueV at the three-loop point (y_s = 0.305-0.389; 0.40 is ADMX-excluded), theta_i = 0.44-0.52 for Omega_a = Omega_DM, isocurvature H_I < 3.2-3.5e7 GeV (1.6e7 conservative), so pre-inflation PQ breaking is forced (also by the relic bound) and no strings or walls form. G3221 -> SM produces no monopoles (degree-1 homotopy map) and its Z_2 strings, the GUT monopoles and the Z_17 strings are all inflated away. Thermal leptogenesis fits in [1e9, 1.1e11] GeV (M_s = 1e13; marginal [1e9, 1.4e10] at M_s = 3e12), demanding M_1 <= 1e10-1e11 from the unresolved G8 fit. Requirements placed on the external inflaton sector: H_I <= 3e7, perturbative reheating, m_phi < 2 M_lightest. New contract items: F.B.H* and Cbar.Pbar.H are X-allowed and R-even. Relic census incomplete: K5 found the three fermion-only U(1) directions (q_Abar, q_N1b, q_Pbar) but did not draw the consequence that the vectorlike 'CP-number' (C:+1, Cbar:-1, P:-1, Pbar:+1; only couplings C.Cbar.S*, Cbar.Pbar.H, P.Pbar.Phi17) makes the lightest C = 16(-6)+16bar(10) state (mass y_C<S> ~ 1e13) exactly stable at the renormalizable level; the report simply asserts the S-sector 16s decay. Verifier (by hand, SO(10) product rules): the lowest X-allowed breaking operator is dim-5, C.A.H*.S/M_P (X: -6+0+2+4 = 0; 16x16 contains 10), y_eff ~ <S>/M_P ~ 1e-5 -> C -> A + H prompt if M_C > M_A, else 3-body via virtual A with tau ~ 1e-2 s (A decays in ~1e-14 s via Abar.F.Phi17*.S^3/M_P^3); direct C-F mixing needs >= 8 fields (Cbar.F.S*^7.Phi17, m_mix ~ 5e-18 GeV, tau ~ 1e3 s). Pre-BBN for O(1) Planck coefficients, so not a kill, but K0 must declare the CP-number and its Planck-operator breaking, and M_C >= M_10 should be part of the configuration (the same T_max < M/20 bound applies to every ~1e13 quasi-stable state). The verifier's own enumeration script (v_cp_sector_decay_ops.py) uses an over-permissive SO(10) rule (e.g. lists Delta.Delta insertions, which contain no 10/126bar) and must not be read as a certificate.

result.summary: Gate K0b PASSES: U(1)_X charge variants of the F17-type sector that remove K0's quality kill exist. Two exact lemmas structure the search: (A) within T_S <= 16 the anomaly conditions force T_S = 14 with all S-scale masses from conj[S], a Phi17-mass sector of net index 4, N = 34, E/N = 8/3 and N_DW = 1 modulo gauge for every variant (the only alternative has N = 0, no axion); (B) a cutting-plane LP whose separation oracle is an exact integer program over all X-neutral, centre- and Lorentz-consistent monomials with 5 <= dim <= 20 gives a rigorous lower bound on the Planck power K of every PQ-violating vacuum diagram closed by renormalizable vertices, monotone under adding fields, which prunes charges (single map |X| <= 100: 16-pairs fail at 29 charges, Phi-pairs at 21) and pairs (box 45: 570/1830 and 486/1586 fail) and certifies complete models. Of ~300 complete anomaly-free models tested, 7 are certified at K_min = 17. Best: v21-F17-B63 = 3x16_F(1) + 16(-35)+16bar(39), 16(-28)+16bar(32), 16(34)+16bar(-30), 2x10(+2) (all conj[S] masses) + a second 16(-35) paired with 16bar(18) by Phi17 + singlets 1(-63)+1(59), 1(-58)+1(54), 1(-57)+1(61), 2x1(-2): anomalies 0, 12 renormalizable structures (no bare mass, no Phi210 or family-exotic Yukawa), N = 34, E/N = 8/3, N_DW = 1, K_min = 17 exactly (certified lower bound; attained by an explicit UV-dominated 4-loop closure 10^-11.8 below the tree operator), so dtheta = dtheta_tree = 2.1e-11 at <S> = 3e13 (1e-10 at 3.29e13); y_s window [0.304, 0.368] at M_s = 1e13 (m_a = 2.09-2.52 ueV, below ADMX); exactly stable colour-neutral lightest R-odd state plus one long-lived colour-neutral 16-sector relic (T_RH << 1e13 as before); T_S = 14, T_Phi = 4 so K1 carries over, K2's 3x3 flavour structure is unchanged, b_X = 101203 requires g_X(M_U) <= 0.013. Alternative A48 (|X| <= 48, a fourth family-like 16) is also certified but changes K2. Costs: charges up to |X| = 63 and 8 singlet Weyl fermions are needed; small-charge assignments fail the bound systematically; non-certified assignments are not proven kills (12 re-checked: no explicit K <= 16 closure among dim <= 8 operators), F17 itself remains the proven kill.
